title: Configurational search and structure optimization
action: Use ATAT to enumerate symmetry-inequivalent configurations for the K3La5Cl18 proto-cell and perform DFT relaxations to identify the lowest-energy structure. Also obtain relaxed unit cells for KCl, LaCl3, K2LaCl5.
description: Perform configurational search via ATAT and DFT structural relaxations for all four compounds, producing the equilibrium structures at 0 K.

title: DFT static energy-volume calculations
action: For each compound, compute total energies at a series of volumes around the equilibrium volume using Quantum ESPRESSO (PBE). Save the E(V) data points.
description: Compute static (0 K) total energies as a function of volume for KCl, LaCl3, K2LaCl5, and the lowest-energy K3La5Cl18 configuration. The E(V) data will be used for EOS fitting.
output_schema: CSV with columns: compound (string), volume_ang3_per_atom (float), energy_eV_per_atom (float)

title: Phonon supercell calculations
action: Using the relaxed structures, perform finite-displacement phonon calculations with Phonopy and Quantum ESPRESSO at the equilibrium volume (or a set of volumes) to obtain phonon frequencies for each compound.
description: Compute phonon frequencies via the finite-displacement supercell method. The resulting data is used to derive thermodynamic properties.

title: Birch-Murnaghan EOS fitting and equilibrium properties
action: Fit the E(V) data to a four-parameter Birch-Murnaghan equation of state and extract the equilibrium volume V0 (ang^3/atom), bulk modulus B0 (GPa), and its pressure derivative B' for each compound. Output the results as dft_static_properties.json.
description: From the computed E(V) data, fit the static equation of state and report the 0 K equilibrium properties.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: KCl, LaCl3, K2LaCl5, K3La5Cl18. Each value is an object with fields: V0_ang3_per_atom (float), B0_GPa (float), B_prime (float).

title: Quasiharmonic thermodynamic property calculations
action: From the phonon frequencies at the equilibrium volume, compute the vibrational Helmholtz free energy and derive temperature-dependent heat capacity Cp, entropy S, and relative enthalpy H-H300 for each compound over a temperature range (e.g., 0–1200 K). Save the full (T, Cp) arrays for later use.
description: Calculate finite-temperature thermodynamic properties using the quasiharmonic approximation. This provides the compound data needed for CALPHAD modeling.
output_schema: CSV with columns: compound (string), temperature_K (float), Cp_J_per_mol_K (float), S_J_per_mol_K (float), H_minus_H300_kJ_per_mol (float)

title: Heat capacity at 500 K
action: Extract the heat capacity at 500 K for K2LaCl5 and K3La5Cl18 from the computed thermodynamic data and write to dft_heat_capacity_500K.json.
description: Report the Cp values at 500 K predicted by the DFT+phonon calculations.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: K2LaCl5 (float, Cp in J/mol-K), K3La5Cl18 (float, Cp in J/mol-K).

title: Compile CALPHAD input dataset
action: Collect experimental phase equilibrium data (liquidus, eutectic temperatures, invariant compositions) for KCl-LaCl3 from Seifert et al. (1985) and Song and Zheng (1995); mixing enthalpy data from Papatheodorou and Ostvold (1974); activity coefficients of LaCl3 in LiCl-KCl from Bagri and Simpson (2016) and Samin et al. (2016); mixing enthalpies in ternary from Goncharov et al. (2024). Combine with the DFT thermodynamic data for compounds (Cp(T), formation enthalpies, etc.) and binary endmember data from SGTE/JANAF. Prepare the dataset in ESPEI-compatible format.
description: Aggregate all required thermodynamic input data for Bayesian optimization.

title: MCMC parameter estimation for KCl-LaCl3 liquid models
action: For each of the four liquid models (Associate-M1, Ionic-M2, MQMQA-M3, MQMQA-M4), run ESPEI MCMC optimization using the compiled dataset. Collect posterior parameter chains and marginal likelihood estimates.
description: Perform Bayesian parameter estimation via MCMC to optimize the interaction parameters and obtain marginal likelihoods.

title: Marginal likelihood and Bayes factor reporting
action: Extract the ln(marginal_likelihood) for each model from the MCMC outputs and write them to marginal_likelihoods.json.
description: Report the estimated marginal likelihoods used for Bayesian model selection.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: Associate_M1 (number), Ionic_M2 (number), MQMQA_M3 (number), MQMQA_M4 (number); each value is the natural logarithm of the marginal likelihood.

title: Ternary MQMQA parameter fitting
action: Fix the binary parameters of the best model (MQMQA-M3) and run MCMC to estimate the ternary interaction parameters for the LiCl-KCl-LaCl3 liquid using ternary experimental data (phase boundaries, activity coefficients, mixing enthalpy).
description: Fit the ternary MQMQA interaction parameters.

title: CALPHAD model parameters
action: Collect the optimized interaction parameters for all four binary models and the ternary model, and write them following the schema in calphad_model_parameters.json.
description: Provide the final fitted CALPHAD model parameters. The checker will use PyCalphad with these parameters to recompute phase boundaries, activity coefficients, and mixing enthalpies and compare with reference values.
output_schema: JSON object containing liquid model parameters for KCl-LaCl3 and LiCl-KCl-LaCl3. It must include, for each model (Associate-M1, Ionic-M2, MQMQA-M3, MQMQA-M4), the interaction parameters as given in the paper; for MQMQA-M3 also the ternary parameters. Numeric values in J/mol or J/mol-K.
